pages.title: Mail from the Sea
pages.text: Distinguish openable finds from ordinary beach decoration.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Collect shells from naturally generated beach blocks. A Message in a Bottle is a separate message/map find whose spawning depends on configuration.

pages.title: Find beach equipment
pages.text: Appropriate shipwrecks, ocean ruins and buried treasure can provide beach equipment according to current loot tables. No particular find is guaranteed.

pages.title: Open a collected seashell
pages.text: Collect natural beach shells and open them as items, or keep them as placed decorations.

pages.title: Open a washed-up bottle
pages.text: Look along beaches for a Message in a Bottle and open it with right-click. It yields a message or map; spawning depends on enablement, intervals and the world limit.
